trust_center.repositoryDescription: Samsara Trust Center containing security documentation, compliance reports, subprocessor information, and FedRAMP program information for the Connected Operations Cloud.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Visit https://security.samsara.com/ and select Request Access. Provide your name, organization, and business email address; access to gated documents is granted after review by the Samsara security team. Publicly available materials on the landing page do not require authentication.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Samsara secure configuration guidance covering administrator account setup, authentication and single sign-on configuration, role-based access control, and recommended security settings for the Connected Operations Cloud, available via the Samsara Trust Center.
secure_configuration_guidance.accessRequestInstructions: Visit https://security.samsara.com/ and select Request Access. Provide your name, organization, and business email address; access to gated documents is granted after review by the Samsara security team.

certified_services.serviceDescription: The Samsara Connected Operations Cloud platform, including fleet telematics, video-based safety, equipment monitoring, driver workflows, and compliance applications, with dashboards, alerting, reporting, and open APIs.

current.service_desc: The Samsara Connected Operations Cloud is a software-as-a-service platform that connects vehicles, equipment, sites, and workers to provide real-time operational visibility. Samsara IoT devices, including vehicle gateways, dash cameras, and environmental sensors, transmit data to the cloud platform, where customers use applications for fleet telematics, video-based safety, equipment monitoring, driver workflows, and regulatory compliance. The platform provides dashboards, alerting, reporting, and open APIs for integration with customer systems.
